reason: Our name is what wins us business at fairs and through referrals, and I won't let an agency I've never heard of send cold emails and phone people in our name. On top of that it's EUR 5,000 at least with no meetings promised, and I'd have to take that to the board with nothing to show them.
objection: If the first time a German or Greek buyer hears of us is a cold email they didn't ask for, or someone at a trade association complains about GDPR, that costs us more than three months of fees. Saying 'legal rules are checked' doesn't tell me who carries the liability.
would_change_my_mind: A reference call with a manufacturer or exporter like us in the CEE region who has run it for six months, plus a written GDPR / legitimate-interest assessment and a contract saying who is the data controller and who is liable.
